source.name: Visa Investor Relations – Visa renews partnership across Red Bull Formula One teams
source.quote: Visa (NYSE: V) today announced a multi-year renewal and expansion of its global partnership with Red Bull F1 Team's Oracle Red Bull Racing and Visa Cash App Racing Bulls

note: Visa renewed across the Red Bull F1 teams from 2026, with on-car branding led by the front wing of the RB22.
